posts.headline: Thicks' Klint's Clipboard climbed to 7-3 but 1092.54 points-for still makes the reigning champ the least scary 7-3 team in football history.
posts.detail: A 1-seed resume with a title to its name should not be scraping by on fumes — this ring is cashing checks the scoreboard can't cash, day 60 of this saga and counting.

posts.headline: Chauncey's talentedtenthh is 2-8 and the name has officially transcended irony into prophecy.
posts.detail: A career 12th-place average finish was the floor, and this team found a way to dig under it — 1035.84 points-for is bottom-feeder behavior from a bottom-feeder franchise.

posts.headline: One Nut Barner's Put it in Ra fell to 3-7 and a 20-8, 1.5-average-finish dynasty resume is now completely unrecognizable.
posts.detail: This is the 60th installment of this disaster and the gap between the career .714 win rate and this season's freefall has never been wider.

posts.headline: Big Head's Sasinci stayed buried at 4-6, and the title defense isn't just dead — it's decomposing.
posts.detail: A former champ with a 13-15 career record and 5.5 average finish, Sasinci's 1097.22 points-for says this ring was a fluke nobody should've trusted.

posts.headline: BIBLE OR THE BELT is 0-10 and Eli's Ultimate Light Skin has officially completed the ten plagues of Egypt in real time.
posts.detail: Drafting a defensive player first overall was the original sin, and a 0-10 record with 1099.4 points-for is the Old Testament-style punishment still being paid out.
